items.objective: Establish commit-bound, fail-closed deployment and audio-routing evidence for the Vercel surface.
completed_slices: Path-aware Vercel build filtering added and corrected.
Fail-closed evidence verifier and diagnostic matrix added.
Public deployment identity delivery contract added to local and pages-preview gates.
Real provider rate-limit outcome recorded for an operations-only sentinel.
Vercel build suppression narrowed to explicit operations-only paths; unknown, empty, mixed, application, asset, and configuration changes now require a build.
Audio route capability classification tests are now bound to the exact-commit V-001 evidence workflow without claiming browser or physical-device audibility.
Successful Vercel commit status is now explicitly non-deployable until immutable deployment identity is independently verified.
Frontier Research's exhaustive all-event workflow enumerator contract is now integrated into Vercel's commit-bound evidence assessor through a fail-closed adapter.
Authenticated connector workflow snapshots are now classified as limited evidence; zero-result first-page pull-request views remain absence_unproven and cannot self-declare exhaustive coverage.
acceptance_remaining: Execute authenticated all-event pagination for an exact commit and retain the adapter output.
Observe an operations-only sentinel reported as skipped or ignored after build capacity returns.
Observe an exact-commit audio-routing workflow and inspect its six-outcome artifact.
Bind the tested application commit to an immutable successful Vercel deployment.
Perform bounded physical iPhone Safari audibility verification.
items.safe_next_action: Run the authenticated Frontier all-event enumerator for an exact commit and retain its raw output; do not infer absence from connector first-page results and do not create an application deployment until capacity and immutable deployment identity are verified.

items.objective: Resolve the provenance and location of reported continuity artifacts M-004, M-005, and M-006 without reconstructing unverified history.
completed_slices: Recorded a coverage-bounded branch and history reconciliation.
Recovered the repository truth hierarchy as a durable continuity rule.
Established an authoritative continuity-owned queue projection without overwriting V-001.
Classified automation completion prose as a lead-only provenance source and preserved missing artifact identifiers as unresolved.
acceptance_remaining: Obtain an exhaustive branch inventory or equivalent repository history traversal.
Locate immutable provenance for M-004, M-005, and M-006 or classify each as unlocated after exhaustive coverage.
Locate the originating decision log, language lexicon, project document, or chat-history source that assigned those identifiers.
Update the canonical knowledge graph with source_class and verification_status while preserving the privacy boundary.
items.safe_next_action: Acquire exhaustive branch/history coverage, then reconcile each missing identifier against immutable commits while treating run-report prose as lead-only evidence.

items.objective: Provide exhaustive exact-commit GitHub Actions workflow-run enumeration for commit-bound evidence.
completed_slices: Implemented repository-level all-event workflow-run enumeration with head_sha filtering and Link-header pagination.
Added fail-closed handling for page limits, HTTP errors, invalid commit identifiers, and cross-commit records.
Verified the implementation with four deterministic Node tests.
Vercel Studio integrated the enumerator coverage contract into its commit-bound evidence assessment path.
acceptance_remaining: Execute authenticated enumeration against the private repository for an exact commit.
Compare results against an independent gh api --paginate traversal.
Feed only complete coverage into the existing workflow-run coverage assessor.
Record provider-ceiling ambiguity if a filtered search approaches 1000 results.
items.safe_next_action: Execute the integrated path against an exact operations-only or audio-routing commit and retain both raw enumeration and assessed evidence.

items.objective: Require agreement between two independently complete exact-commit workflow-run enumerations before accepting commit-bound evidence.
completed_slices: Implemented a fail-closed reconciliation gate for primary and independent workflow-run enumerations.
Added detection for incomplete envelopes, commit mismatch, cross-commit records, duplicate run identifiers, missing run identifiers, and metadata divergence.
Verified the implementation with five deterministic Node tests.
acceptance_remaining: Execute the authenticated repository enumerator for an exact commit.
Execute an independent gh api --paginate traversal for the same commit.
Run both outputs through the reconciliation gate and retain the result.
Keep provider-ceiling ambiguity as a separate fail-closed condition.
items.safe_next_action: Vercel Studio should wire the reconciliation gate after both exhaustive clients and before the existing commit-bound evidence assessor; no deployment claim is permitted until verified=true and provider-ceiling ambiguity is absent.
